summary: Expose one completed reconciliation/process-cost window through request latency

replay.detail: No claims, projection, admission, authority or effect changes.

schema.detail: In-memory diagnostics only; no table/index/trigger or numeric schema change.

rules.detail: Rules, digests and checkpoint format unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Add cost_counters to existing read.projections request-latency response, preserving routes. Disabled/missing windows and unavailable source/CPU are explicit. Completed profiled reconcile operations include errors; SQL belongs to that task scope, with direct/unprofiled/unfinished exclusions. Process CPU uses the process clock. managed_outer_commits is PARTIAL, includes no-op outer commits, excludes raw/autocommit/SQL BEGIN-COMMIT and private direct abortable commits. Counts are neither total writes, claim rows nor durable ACKs. Sequential boundary sampling is disclosed; no profiler activation, endpoint file/DB scan, new timer or collector.

manual.detail: No new activation or configuration. Cost windows exist only when existing profiling is already enabled.

recovery.detail: Compatible rollback removes the added response field and diagnostic atomic increments; no durable state conversion.
